snippet.title: Pain Pain Go Away!: Final Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
[Steam Store Page]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3127750/Pain_Pain_Go_Away/

[Pain Pain Go Away! Official X]
https://x.com/Lorebard_info

Psychotherapy Typing Adventure Game: "Pain Pain Go Away!"

An unconventional typing adventure game where you erase the "trauma words" that torment runaway girls by typing them out!
Not only speed, but also accuracy—and sometimes even deductive reasoning—are required to progress through the story.


■ Story of "Pain Pain Go Away!"
You are a counselor at a small clinic. Using a special counseling device called “P2GA,” you dive into the subconscious of your patients to heal their wounded hearts.
One day, a girl named Kokoromi visits, convinced that she has "killed her mother." What is the true nature of the “pain” lurking deep within her mind? As you trace her fragmented memories, the truth gradually comes to light…

■ Demo Release Confirmed!
The demo version (Japanese & English) will be available on Steam starting Friday, July 18.
Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned!

■ Full Release Scheduled for spring 2026.
The full version is scheduled for release in spring 2026.
It will feature six difficulty levels and full language support in Japanese, English, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.

■ Developed by Lorebard
Lorebard is a new adventure game brand from Story Note.
Our mission: to deliver innovative, story-driven adventure games the world has never seen before.
Our first title is "Pain Pain Go Away!".

#indie 
#typing 
#P2GA
